$comment: Temporary high/critical advisory allowlist read by the CI audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs).
An entry is ONLY justified when a fix exists but is currently un-installable under .npmrc
min-release-age=7 (the patched version is published but <7 days old). Each entry MUST be
converted to an npm `overrides` pin and DELETED from this file once its fix ages past
min-release-age (see `ageInOn`). The gate FAILS on ANY high/critical advisory NOT listed here,
so the allowlist never weakens the gate for un-triaged findings. Reviewed by the Architect.
STATUS 2026-06-18: empty. The three prior entries (form-data GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx, vite

cleanly while .npmrc keeps min-release-age=7 for all other (future) dependency resolution.
